createFor: Create a rule for mail from {address}
help: Applies to the next messages that reach this mailbox's Inbox. Spam and blocked senders stay out.
noFolders: This mailbox has no folders yet. Create one from a message's Move button.
noBoxes: You have no other mailbox of your own on this team.
applyExisting: Also apply to messages already in the Inbox
existingCounting: Counting the messages already in the Inbox…
existingCount: {count, plural, =0 {No messages from them in the Inbox now.} one {# message in the Inbox now.} other {# messages in the Inbox now.}}
existingMore: More than {count} messages in the Inbox now; the first {count} will be organized.
existingBox: For another mailbox, the rule applies to the next messages only.
needAction: Choose a destination or tick an option.
invalidDomain: Enter a valid domain, like company.com.
saved: Rule saved. The next messages from {match} follow it.
savedApplied: Rule saved and applied to {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} in the Inbox.
savedPartial: Rule saved. {done} of {total} Inbox messages were organized; the rest changed meanwhile.
limit: This mailbox has reached 500 rules. Delete one before creating another.
forbidden: Only the mailbox's owner creates rules for it and for the destination mailbox.
notFound: The chosen folder or mailbox no longer exists.
error: Couldn't save the rule. Try again.
unavailable: Automatic rules aren't available right now. Try again later.
listHint: Mail from a sender or domain goes straight to a folder, the Archive or another mailbox of yours, already read if you like. Rules apply to the next messages.
empty: No rules yet. Create one here or with Create rule when a message is open.
folderMissing: The folder was archived: the message stays in the Inbox.
boxMissing: The destination mailbox is no longer available: the message stays here.
